name: docker-service
description: Scaffold a single-container infrastructure resource managed through a Docker-oriented runtime contract.

RESOURCE_PORTABILITY_TIER.description: Portability tier for the generated scaffold.

platformExpectations: Docker must be installed on any host that runs this resource.
The Go control plane owns orchestration; shell wrappers are not required for generated scaffolds.
Scenario-facing environment variables must be declared through environment_exports in resource.json.
